conditions: Night visibility may affect vision systems

claims.text: DJI Matrice 4T describes Failsafe RTH and AR/Original Route RTH behaviors, with safety considerations during low-light or GNSS issues.
claims.quote: Loss of remote controller signal When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH... If the RTH distance is farther than 50 m, the aircraft adjusts its orientation and flies backward for 50 m on its original flight route before entering Preset RTH.
conditions: Lighting conditions can affect vision systems and RTH performance

claims.text: Autel Evo Max 4N documents signal-loss behavior (Return to Home, Hover, Land) and reconnection logic, including continuation of RTH during signal loss.
claims.quote: The drone will enter a reconnection state when the C2 (Command & Control) link is lost, continuously attempting to re-establish connection with the ground control station.

claims.text: DJI Matrice 210 V1 describes Failsafe RTH and limitations when GPS signal is weak or unavailable, with controlled descent/landing behaviors.
claims.quote: Failsafe RTH will be automatically activated if the remote controller signal is lost... The aircraft cannot return to the Home Point when GPS signal is weak or unavailable.
conditions: Night operations require reliable GPS and link stability
